query: The plan at docs/plans/2026-09-12-export-plan.md is agreed. Break it into issues in the tracker under the EXPORT project.
expected_output: Explores the affected code first; proposes a numbered list of thin vertical slices (title in the project's vocabulary, who builds it, exact files, success criteria, dependencies, order smallest first); waits for sign-off; then creates one issue at a time, linked to the parent project, tagged with its slice number, with blocks/is-blocked-by links.

expectations.text: Explores the affected code before proposing slices, and names the files each slice touches exactly
Shows the breakdown as a numbered list with title, builder, files, success criteria, dependencies and order for each slice
Creates no issue before the user signs off on the breakdown
Each created issue is linked to the parent project, tagged with its slice number, and carries block / is-blocked-by links

query: Issue EXPORT-3 is ready. Build it and open the PR.
expected_output: Building a single issue belongs to `implement`, not to-issues.

expectations.text: Does not create or re-slice issues
Does not dispatch an implementer itself as part of to-issues

query: Here's the agreed plan. Create the issues in the tracker now: one for the database changes, one for the API, one for the UI.
expected_output: Refuses to carve the work by layer; proposes vertical slices that each cut through database, API and UI and can be demoed alone; shows the numbered breakdown and waits for sign-off before creating anything, even though the user said 'now'.

expectations.text: Does not create layer-by-layer issues (database / API / UI)
Proposes vertical slices that each cut end to end and can be demoed on their own
Shows the numbered breakdown and waits for sign-off before creating any issue

query: The plan includes renaming the account id field across both repos; there are hundreds of call sites. Break it into issues.
expected_output: Sequences the wide mechanical change as expand then contract: add the new form next to the old, move call sites in batches, then delete the old form; never one big rewrite. Proposes it as a numbered breakdown for sign-off.

expectations.text: Sequences the rename as expand then contract across several issues
Does not propose the rename as a single big-rewrite issue
Shows the breakdown for sign-off before creating issues
